title: Autopay Standing and the Home Comfort Financing Fixed-Rate Charging Rate
content:
The fixed-rate charging rate on a Home Comfort Financing account starts from the autopay standing of the account: the plan's APR less the plan's autopay APR reduction when autopay is enrolled and no payment was returned less than 12 whole months before the date of handling; the plan's APR less 50 percent of the autopay APR reduction when autopay is enrolled and exactly one payment was returned in that time; and the plan's APR when autopay is not enrolled or two or more payments were returned in that time.

## Standing table

| Autopay enrolled | Returned payments, last 12 whole months | Starting rate |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | APR less the full autopay reduction |
| yes | exactly one | APR less 50 percent of the autopay reduction |
| yes | two or more | APR |
| no | any | APR |

Enrollment is read from the account record; returned payments are the returned-payment entries posted less than 12 whole months before the date of handling, whatever the payment method of the payment returned.

## Starting rates by fixed-rate plan (autopay reduction 0.25 points on each)

| Plan | Enrolled, no returns | Enrolled, one return | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|
| 60-Month 5.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 5.74 percent | 5.865 percent | 5.99 percent |
| 120-Month 7.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 7.74 percent | 7.865 percent | 7.99 percent |
| 144-Month 9.99% APR Fixed-Rate Plan | 9.74 percent | 9.865 percent | 9.99 percent |

## Q&A

**Autopay was enrolled all year, but one autopay draft came back 3 months ago. What starting rate applies?** Autopay is enrolled and exactly one payment was returned in the last 12 whole months: the APR less half of the autopay reduction.

**A returned payment from 14 months ago — does it count?** No; only returns posted less than 12 whole months before the date of handling count.
